simple.meaning: נְסַךְ (nᵉçak) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a libation.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Ezra, beginning at Ezra 7:17. Its contexts include offering, altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְסַךְ (H5261).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
